units.source_text: 约莫过了几分钟，我觉察到自己受到了侵犯，不得不睁开眼观察周围。

en.t: After a few minutes or so, I sensed that I had been intruded upon and had no choice but to open my eyes and look around.

units.source_text: 对面的姑娘不知何时坐到我旁边了，并且固执的想要打开我旁边的车窗。

en.t: The girl who had been sitting opposite me had somehow moved to my side and was stubbornly trying to open the train window beside me.

units.source_text: 然而厚重的玻璃窗没有那么容易被打开。

en.t: But the heavy glass window was not so easy to open.

units.source_text: 她那充斥着皲裂的脸颊更红了，她不停的吸着鼻涕声，微弱的喘息声，不由分辩的闯进我的耳际。

en.t: Her chapped cheeks grew even redder, and the sound of her constant sniffling and faint panting forced its way into my ears.

units.source_text: 她这个糟糕的样子令我心中生出了几分同情。

en.t: Her wretched appearance stirred a measure of pity in me.

units.source_text: 苍茫的暮色下，只能看见两旁山脊上干枯的草，此刻直逼到眼前，由此可见火车马上就要驶进隧道了。

en.t: In the vast dusk, only the dry grass on the ridges to either side could be seen, now pressing close before my eyes, which showed that the train was about to enter a tunnel.

units.source_text: 我不知道这姑娘为什么要打开车窗。

en.t: I did not know why the girl wanted to open the train window.

units.source_text: 不，我只能说，她也许是一时心血来潮的想法。

en.t: No, all I could say was that perhaps it was a passing whim of hers.

units.source_text: 就这样，我抱着不快的情绪，希望她永远也打不开车窗，冷眼旁观着那双生了冻疮的手费劲要打开车窗的情景。

en.t: So, feeling displeased and hoping she would never manage to open the window, I watched coldly as those frostbitten hands struggled to force it open.

units.source_text: 不一会儿，伴随着凄厉的鸣笛声，火车冲进了隧道；同时，姑娘费尽力气想要打开的那扇玻璃窗“咯噔”一声落了下来，开了。

en.t: Before long, with a piercing whistle, the train plunged into the tunnel; at the same moment, the glass window the girl had been straining to open dropped down with a clatter and opened.

units.source_text: 方形窗洞，瞬间涌进来一股浓黑的煤烟和令人窒息的烟屑。

en.t: Through the square opening, a cloud of dense black coal smoke and choking soot instantly poured in.

units.source_text: 我来不及用手绢捂住自己的脸，就被喷了一脸的黑烟，原本就嗓子不舒服的我，立马被呛得咳嗽的上气不接下气。

en.t: Before I could cover my face with my handkerchief, black smoke sprayed all over me, and since my throat had already been bothering me, I immediately choked and coughed until I could hardly breathe.

units.source_text: 姑娘却根本不在乎我，她把头伸到窗外，一动不动的盯着火车行进的前方，黑暗中刮来的风将她绾着银杏髻的鬓发自在飞扬。

en.t: The girl, however, paid me no attention at all; she thrust her head out the window and stared motionlessly ahead along the train's path, while the wind blowing from the darkness sent the hair at her ginkgo-shaped coiffure flying freely.

units.source_text: 煤烟和灯光里，姑娘的形影清晰可见。

en.t: In the coal smoke and lamplight, the girl's figure could be seen clearly.

units.source_text: 这个时候，窗外渐渐明亮起来，泥土、枯草、水的不同气味凉凉的扑到我的脸上，我这才停下了咳嗽，否则，我一定会痛骂这个姑娘一顿，让她关好窗户。

en.t: At that moment, the world outside the window gradually brightened, and the different smells of earth, dry grass, and water blew coolly against my face; only then did I stop coughing, otherwise I would surely have cursed the girl and made her shut the window properly.
